title: Programme Charter and Scope Freeze
deliverable: signed product glossary, outcomes, in/out boundaries, free API policy, source-of-truth statement, first pilot definition and architecture decision records
acceptance: all pillars share one graph, no duplicate service definitions, no paid core API, phase authority named; rejected requirements tracked
fallback: park unbounded features in future register

title: Open Technology, API and Data-Licence Register
deliverable: machine-readable inventory of software, public endpoints, downloadable datasets, local model weights, commercial use terms, attribution and snapshots
acceptance: each required dependency F0/F1 approved; no noncommercial-only model in a commercial runtime; egress policy tested; public OSM servers excluded from production

title: Zimbabwe Legal, Employment and Sector Controls
deliverable: data-protection, consumer, labour, mining, regulated professional, agricultural, trade and child-safeguarding requirements
acceptance: launch blockers and prohibited offerings signed off; appeals and privacy policy drafted; no unexplained personal-data processing

title: Canonical Domain and Integration Boundaries
deliverable: service/context map, UUID rules, transaction authority, public/private projections, ADR-001–014
acceptance: independently reviewed sequence diagrams prove one listing and one place identity across Skills/Communities/GEO
fallback: defer integration adapters rather than duplicating identity

title: Local-first Repository, CI and Evidence Harness
deliverable: reproducible developer environment, lint/typechecks, test database, container definitions, seeded demo, security scan, local URL and documented commands
acceptance: fresh clone starts offline with fixtures; automated tests reproducible; production untouched; no paid API credentials

title: Canonical Schema, Temporal Relations and Migration Governance
deliverable: ERD, Postgres/PostGIS schema, RLS design, migrations, invariants, merge redirects, event ledger, audit and rollback
acceptance: duplicate names, no-geometry village, multi-role party, multi-group offer, boundary history, inventory ownership and failed atomic writes all pass
fallback: reduce scope but never weaken invariants

title: Authorization, Privacy and Secrets Authority
deliverable: RBAC/ABAC and object access, client scopes, encrypted sensitive locations, consent records, secrets and response projections
acceptance: role-switch, enumeration, private-location and broken-object-auth tests fail closed; audit events emitted

title: Open Dataset Acquisition and Import Quarantine
deliverable: signed source manifest and immutable snapshot mechanism for Zimbabwe Geoportal, Geofabrik, GeoNames and approved public references
acceptance: old/uncertain geometry not mislabelled current, source date preserved, licence recorded, bad records quarantined and import reversible
fallback: manual verified seed of pilot places

title: National Occupation and Service Dictionary
deliverable: 24 browse families, initial canonical occupations, skills, customer tasks, aliases, multi-role relationships, sector tags and ISCO/ESCO crosswalk provenance
acceptance: sampled village wording and urban job terms resolve to correct reusable concepts; no occupation created from an unchecked AI phrase
fallback: allow searchable provisional descriptor without canonical publication

title: Goods, Produce, Units, Rental and Mining Sector Facets
deliverable: goods classification; standard/locally described units; grades, packaging, expiry; restrictions; equipment rental; verified mining-industry *service* facets
acceptance: '20 crates' remains 20 crates unless validated conversion; unsafe/regulated goods gated; product and skill distinctions maintained

title: Canonical Zimbabwe Place Gazetteer
deliverable: versioned province/district/ward references and provisional villages, local aliases, landmarks, geometry status, source lineages
acceptance: identical village names remain distinct; source confidence visible; no autogenerated exact household points
fallback: region-based browse plus named local landmarks

title: Location Passport and Place Resolution API
deliverable: place lookup by text, alias, nearby public landmark, optional GPS, Plus Code/H3, uncertainty and no-coordinate state
acceptance: user can register by village name alone; ambiguous village prompts for district/landmark; private address never returned in public API

title: Self-hosted Map Tiles, Gazetteer Search and Attribution
deliverable: self-generated vector tiles, MapLibre web map, OSM/GeoNames attribution, own place autocomplete; offline package source
acceptance: app still runs after disabling public OSM tiles, Nominatim and Overpass; licence notices shown; map/list parity

title: Spatial Assertions, Review Queue and Map My Village
deliverable: audio/text/photo landmark submissions, uncertain observations, independent review, dispute queue and versioned publication
acceptance: two contradictory ward claims preserved; mapper cannot unilaterally verify official place; offline submission sync retries safe

title: Verified Routes, Hubs and Seasonal Accessibility
deliverable: directional transport-node graph, collection hub registry, Valhalla integration, explicit route-source dates, mode and confidence
acceptance: unmapped road returns 'unknown'; no invented ETA; demonstrable hub-to-market route only after evidence

title: Multi-role Account and Provider Skills Passport
deliverable: persons, organizations, consented provider profiles, capability claims, portfolios, verification distinctions, multi-area coverage
acceptance: one person can be both buyer and multi-skill provider; no self-declared qualification renders as verified
fallback: hide unverified badge, not provider identity

title: Unified Offer, Work Request and Search
deliverable: typed drafts, publication, expiry, filters, category and location search, photo uploads and quote invitations
acceptance: all offer types remain one canonical object family; unpublished drafts not visible; owners cannot mutate each other's offers; duplicate submissions idempotent

title: Quotation, Agreement, Completion and Review
deliverable: proposal versions, explicit acceptance, work/delivery milestones, disputes, eligible verified reviews and manual settlement-evidence label
acceptance: an accepted quote freezes terms; every completion/review linked to work record; payment never asserted from a screenshot alone

title: Canonical Community, Group and Membership Registry
deliverable: place-linked community identity, faceted group taxonomy, roles, member consent and visibility scopes
acceptance: multi-village group and multiple groups in one village work; no group inherits private subgroup data; group admin cannot change verified credential
fallback: group listing disabled until auth passes

title: Structured Group Marketplace and Native Feed
deliverable: searchable group offers, jobs, regional announcements, referrals and moderation
acceptance: shared offer keeps single owner/stock ID; deleting group post does not erase order history; visibility enforced
fallback: group share links and public listings only

title: Claims, Credentials, Reviews, Moderation and Appeals
deliverable: independent identity/profile/credential claims, business checks, abuse reports, evidence retention and appeal flows
acceptance: group endorsements never become verified licences; minors/high-risk data protected; impersonation reports can be resolved with audit

title: Community Agent and Cooperative Identity Program
deliverable: agents, organization representatives, delegated consent, prohibited agent custody, quality scoring and fees policy
acceptance: farmer retains account and stock; agent actions traceable; consent can be withdrawn

title: Local Model Gateway and Model Licence Audit
deliverable: self-hosted inference abstraction for chosen LLM/embeddings/ASR/TTS, exact model weights/version/licence and resource budget
acceptance: no paid model endpoint invoked; fallback deterministic UI works when local model is offline

title: Structured Intent, Place and Taxonomy Entity Resolution
deliverable: intent schemas, slot extraction, unit/currency/place ambiguity tests, retrieval-grounded recommendations
acceptance: no guessed price, village or unit is persisted; ambiguous entities demand clarification

title: AI Action Gateway with Permissioned Tool Contracts
deliverable: typed tools, action classes, confirmation, actor scopes, no SQL, idempotency, prompt-injection tests and audit events
acceptance: a forged tool output cannot publish or move funds; repeated prompts create one permitted transaction

title: English, Shona and Zimbabwean Ndebele Dataset and Baselines
deliverable: representative consented benchmark, licence-checked public corpus subsets, domain lexicon and baseline WER/CER, place name and number accuracy by dialect/device/noise
acceptance: no language marketed as supported without passing bounded end-to-end tasks; no unlicensed model training
fallback: typed/native language and human-assisted voice note processing

title: Local Voice Listing and Search Assistant
deliverable: record/playback, recognition, clarification, spoken/text response, listing draft and confirmation in qualified languages
acceptance: task works under poor microphone/network test; quantity and place verified before publication; voice failure yields text path

title: MCP Servers, OAuth Scope and Tool Isolation
deliverable: taxonomy, geo, market, community and support servers exposing minimal declared tools/resources; protocol tests
acceptance: user A cannot retrieve user B records; no token passthrough; direct host actions require authorized tool calls; logs redacted

title: Community, Buyer, Provider and Support Agents
deliverable: tested role-specific agent flows, citations to records, bounded context and human escalation
acceptance: group-only information never revealed outside group; support agent cannot secretly reset credentials; responses show evidence/uncertainty

title: Computer Vision and Geographic Inference Queue
deliverable: opt-in listing photo classifications, inferred feature candidates and confidence; human review
acceptance: model-suggested building/road never directly becomes verified village/parcel; imagery licences checked

title: Transport Provider and Vehicle Service Profiles
deliverable: declared route, mode, capacity, availability, driver qualifications/vehicle details where applicable
acceptance: no vehicle suitability inferred from voice alone; user location not permanently tracked
fallback: verified route descriptions and pickup phone/contact

title: Collection Hub and Chain-of-Custody
deliverable: bookings, handoff actors, time, quantity/condition checks, evidence, exception reports, owner/shipper distinctions
acceptance: producer ownership and group allocations survive multiple handoffs; missing proof generates unresolved status

title: Driver Voice Assistant and Route Observation
deliverable: short safe task-scoped commands, route/road-condition reports, pickup confirmation, offline message queue
acceptance: no complex prompts while driving; GPS opt-in; no false all-weather road from one journey

title: Economic Zone and Producer Aggregation
deliverable: functional market zones, multiple-village supply pools, buyer demand, supplier allocations and consent
acceptance: individual supplier quantity and proceeds not lost; zone != official district designation

title: Analytics Events, Coverage Metrics and Dashboards
deliverable: privacy-aware aggregate supply/demand, event QA, coverage completeness, transaction vs listing-price separation
acceptance: every geographic insight displays coverage/data freshness; small groups not re-identifiable
fallback: reviewed CSV reports with no personal data

title: Demand, Opportunity and Seasonal Forecasting
deliverable: baseline forecasting, uncertainty, drift monitoring, route/market scenarios
acceptance: evaluated against held-out periods and geography; no fabricated 'current market price' when data missing

title: Diaspora Procurement and Verified Local Work
deliverable: remote requests, photo-evidenced milestones, international customer privacy and payment-neutral agreements
acceptance: remote buyer can inspect evidence and dispute; no promise of free international payment APIs

title: Mining, Highlands, Water and Remote Site Access Profiles
deliverable: safe permitted public site registry, regulated jobs/qualifications, offline terrain and site-gated logistics
acceptance: underground GPS not assumed, mine confidentiality respected, no licence-gated offers without checks
fallback: above-ground publicly safe area and inquiry-only listings

title: Multi-province Expansion and Local-language Coverage
deliverable: region onboarding playbook, language and geography scorecards, mapping reviewers and support network
acceptance: new regions pass same pilot quality gates; no map coverage represented as complete without evidence

title: Economic GEO Intelligence Console
deliverable: layered maps, filters, map-source traceability, geographic coverage gaps, demand/supply overlays and route confidence
acceptance: small-area privacy tests, sources visible, no individual live tracking

title: 3D Digital Terrain and Economic Twin Pilot
deliverable: self-hosted CesiumJS pilot over verified public places, licensed terrain/3D Tiles, scenario metadata
acceptance: source and hypothetical overlays distinguished; no paid ion/tiles; frame time and accessibility measured

title: AR / VR Field Navigation and Scenario Exploration
deliverable: bounded safe public-hub AR experiment or VR economic-zone simulation
acceptance: tested physical safety, no fake route guarantee, device accessibility and consent

title: Tengasell Compatibility and Contract Audit
urgency: PLANNED P2; execution requires Owner authorization
deliverable: identity/listings/search/media/payments/notifications mapping and change-risk assessment
acceptance: zero production mutation, exact-lineage custody and tested reversible adapters

title: Authorized Tengasell Integration
urgency: VISION P3; explicit separate release approval
deliverable: approved shared navigation/identity/linkage through stable APIs, tests and rollback
acceptance: native Tengasell features unaffected, staging first, exact versions, no unauthorized merges

title: Canonical Data and Geographic Invariant Tests
deliverable: versioned fixtures and DB/API tests for duplicated villages, no-coordinate places, overlapping jurisdictions, merge lineage, multi-skill identity, transaction ownership, group scopes, import rollback
acceptance: no invariant bypass in normal and adversarial tests

title: Multilingual Voice and Agent Red-Team Certification
deliverable: dialect/noise dataset, WER/CER, intent, number, monetary value, place, prompt-injection and hallucination reports
acceptance: high-risk errors block launch; performance reported per language rather than averaged away

title: Rural Physical UAT, Offline and Low-end Device Matrix
deliverable: actual 2G/3G/spotty data or simulated connectivity, Android budget devices, human agent path and accessibility evidence
acceptance: multi-step job works and resumes; no silently lost voice drafts or duplicate orders

title: Privacy, Licensing, Security, Load and Restore Certification
deliverable: penetration testing, MCP tool isolation, no-licence violations, documented egress deny, load envelope, backup restore, deletion and legal gates
acceptance: P0 findings closed; production cost/API policy attested

title: Launch Runbooks, Incident Response and Owner Controls
deliverable: on-call ownership, moderation coverage, legal notices, abuse/incident escalation, dashboards, outage/offline mode, data rollback and public source attributions
acceptance: tabletop incident, compromised moderator, provider fraud and GIS corruption exercises passed

title: Rust workspace and module boundaries
deliverable: Pinned toolchain; domain crates; API boundary contracts
acceptance: Workspace builds reproducibly; no cross-domain authority bypass
fallback: No paid API; stop or reduce scope

title: TrailBase canonical data proof
deliverable: Version-pinned TrailBase/SQLite; authentication; migrations; backup
acceptance: Auth, writes, restore and rollback experimentally proven
fallback: No paid API; stop or reduce scope

title: SQLite/H3 geospatial qualification
deliverable: R*Tree, H3O and geo query proof with no-coordinate villages
acceptance: Correct candidate filtering, polygon checks, uncertainty and access controls
fallback: No paid API; stop or reduce scope

title: TrailBase concurrency and recovery test
deliverable: Concurrent writes, load envelope, backup restore evidence
acceptance: No data loss; contention envelope documented; recovery successful
fallback: No paid API; stop or reduce scope

title: Local Rust-compatible inference qualification
deliverable: Local inference gateway; commercial weight licence matrix
acceptance: Safe structured output, model fallback, CPU/GPU costs documented
fallback: No paid API; stop or reduce scope

title: Scoped MCP and Rust action gateway
deliverable: Tool contracts, permissions, approvals and audit events
acceptance: No AI tool can bypass transaction authorization or leak private data
fallback: No paid API; stop or reduce scope

title: Low-end device UI framework proof
deliverable: Compare Dioxus with mobile alternatives on low-end Android
acceptance: Microphone/GPS/offline maps/accessibility measured physically
fallback: No paid API; stop or reduce scope

title: Self-hosted Martin/MapLibre map prototype
deliverable: Legal map packages, self-hosted tiles, offline browse
acceptance: No production reliance on public OSM tiles/geocoding
fallback: No paid API; stop or reduce scope
